name: tilttek/activity-bundle
description: The journal of members' activity for Symfony on tilttek/activity: the journal and checkpoints in Doctrine DBAL, declared verbs, projections and observers kept up to date live, through Messenger or by a command, the rebuild of a projection after a rule changed, and the export and erasure of a member for phil/privacy-bundle

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the journal's tables to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's activity with the rest of their account
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that catch up, rebuild and list the projections
suggest.symfony/messenger: To keep the projections up to date out of the request, by a message for each new entry
